statement: The crown produced diffs nobody reviewed. This gate reviews the produced diff the senior-engineer way: compile baseline (stdlib, always) + ruff F/E/W sweep intersected with the diff's new-side changed line ranges. Golden leg: NL issue -> orchestrator diff -> gate PASS. Sabotage leg: same diff plus an injected undefined-name line -> gate FAIL with F821 evidence on the changed line. Both legs measured; byte-identical artifacts on rerun.
